actions.creative_upscale.description: Upscale a small or degraded image to 4K, reimagining details (60 credits). Runs as a background job; optionally waits up to 4 minutes for the result.
actions.creative_upscale.props.creativit: 0.1 to 0.5: how much new detail may be added. Stability AI uses 0.3 when empty.
actions.creative_upscale.props.image.des: Image to upscale: 4,096 to 1,048,576 pixels in total.
actions.creative_upscale.props.negative_: What you do not want to see in the output image.
actions.creative_upscale.props.output_fi: Name for the saved image. The extension is added from the output format. Leave empty for an automatic name.
actions.creative_upscale.props.output_fo: File type of the upscaled image. Defaults to WebP: a 4x PNG can exceed the Activepieces file size limit (10 MB on Cloud), in which case the credits are charged but the file cannot be saved.
PNG (can exceed the file size limit)
actions.creative_upscale.props.prompt.de: What you want to see in the output image. Write it in English: Stability AI moderation may refuse non-English prompts with a 403 error, at no charge.
actions.creative_upscale.props.seed.desc: Value from 0 to 4294967294 that makes results repeatable. Leave empty or use 0 for a random seed.
actions.creative_upscale.props.style_pre: Guides the image model towards a particular style.
actions.creative_upscale.props.wait_for_: Yes: check every 10 seconds for up to 4 minutes after the job is sent and return the image when it is ready. No: return the generation ID right away; use Get Generation Result to fetch the image later.

actions.text-to-image.description: Generate images from a text prompt with the legacy SDXL 1.0 engine. For newer models use Generate Image.
actions.text-to-image.props.cfg_scale.de: How strictly the diffusion process adheres to the prompt text (higher values keep your image closer to your prompt). 1–35; 0 or empty uses the default (7).
actions.text-to-image.props.engine_id.de: Stable Diffusion XL 1.0 is the only engine Stability AI still documents for this endpoint.
actions.text-to-image.props.height.descr: Height of the image in pixels. SDXL 1.0 accepts only these width x height pairs: 1024x1024, 1152x896, 896x1152, 1216x832, 832x1216, 1344x768, 768x1344, 1536x640, 640x1536. Defaults to 1024.
actions.text-to-image.props.prompt.descr: The text to transform in image.
actions.text-to-image.props.samples.desc: Number of images to generate (MIN:1; MAX:10). Defaults to 1.
actions.text-to-image.props.steps.descri: Number of diffusion steps to run (MIN:10; MAX:50). Defaults to 50. Each image costs 0.9 credits up to 30 steps and 0.9 x steps / 30 credits above that.
actions.text-to-image.props.style_preset: Pass in a style preset to guide the image model towards a particular style.
actions.text-to-image.props.weight.descr: Weight of the prompt. Defaults to 1.
actions.text-to-image.props.width.descri: Width of the image in pixels. Must form an allowed SDXL 1.0 pair with the height (see height). Defaults to 1024.
actions.upscale_image.description: Enlarge an image. Fast: 4x larger in about a second (2 credits), input at most 1024x1024 pixels. Conservative: up to 4 megapixels with minimal changes (40 credits, needs a prompt).
actions.upscale_image.props.creativity.d: Conservative mode only, 0.2 to 0.5: how much new detail may be added. Stability AI uses 0.35 when empty.
actions.upscale_image.props.image.descri: Fast: 32 to 1536 px per side and at most 1,048,576 pixels in total (for example 1024x1024). Conservative: at least 64 px per side and 4,096 to 9,437,184 pixels.
actions.upscale_image.props.mode.descrip: Fast: 2 credits, 4x size, input at most 1,048,576 pixels (1024x1024), so 1536x1536 Core or Ultra images are too large. Conservative: 40 credits, 4 megapixel output, requires a prompt.
actions.upscale_image.props.negative_pro: Conservative mode only: what you do not want in the output.
actions.upscale_image.props.output_file_: Name for the saved image. The extension is added from the output format. Leave empty for an automatic name.
actions.upscale_image.props.output_forma: File type of the upscaled image. Defaults to WebP: a 4x PNG can exceed the Activepieces file size limit (10 MB on Cloud), in which case the credits are charged but the file cannot be saved.
PNG (can exceed the file size limit)
actions.upscale_image.props.prompt.descr: Conservative mode only, required there: an English description of the image.
actions.upscale_image.props.seed.descrip: Conservative mode only: 0 to 4294967294 for repeatable results. Leave empty or 0 for random.
